notes.title: WDC World Oceans Day Charity Sale 🐬
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757573/2d214bc970c53cf8782c55c2ca70f2f527d8c607.png 

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Oceans Day! 

The WDC World Oceans Day Sale starts today and runs until 15th June, 10am PDT 2023, and you can save a fin-tastic 50% off Mars Horizon 1 and 90% off Dark Future: Blood Red States. We will also donate 20% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.*  

Mars Horizon 2: The Search for Life is also included in this event as an upcoming title, make sure you wishlist and follow! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/e16eb797ea21a8804a92921c56bbacb66269a1f9.jpg Photo credit: Shutterstock

WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.  

Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by:  

  Stopping cruelty from deliberate harms such as whaling and captivity.  
 Creating safe seas, free from the threat of pollution, collisions with vessels and accidental entanglement in fishing gear.  
 Winning recognition of whales and dolphins as sentient, socially complex beings, and our allies in the fight against climate and nature breakdown.  
 Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. They have suffered from terrible harm - deliberate and accidental - and their homes and populations are under threat. But it's not too late.   
 Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused.    

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: https://whales.org/  

You can find many other amazing games in the sale here: https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale23   

Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! 🐳 

*20% of our net developer revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705)

notes.title: Patch Notes: 28th May 2020, Mytholmroyd
notes.content:
Hello all,

This update adds new Player Vehicle Skins with which to look extra stylish while dealing death to your fellow road users. If you’ve unlocked a character that uses the corresponding vehicle then you can assign that skin regardless of whether you’ve completed their Season.

If you missed some of our previous updates, click the links below to see what’s been added since launch;

Duffield (20th May 2019)
Mugginton (22nd May 2019)
Coxbench (28th May 2019)
Meenacladdy (7th June 2019)
Ballyhillin (25th June 2019)
Suckley (11th November 2019)

Improvements

- Added five new Player Vehicle Skins: True Fan (Interceptor Light), Omega (Civilian Vehicle), Go Fasta (T-Bird Thunder), Blocked (Interceptor Light), Hexed (Interceptor Medium).

Bug Fixes

- Fixed typo: rogue apostrophe on Tutorial.
- Fixed typo: the Guided Rockets now fire in a “salvo”.

Want to swap strategies or share road war stories? Fancy a peek at what the studio is up to next? Head on over to our Discord and official website.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Our latest update is now live - plus competitions and podcasts!
notes.content:
Hi there!
 
 Our latest update is now live!  
 The Suckley update  focuses on improving visibility for achievement progress, introduces the ability to swap between vehicle skins, and brings with it bug fixes and some other minor improvements to the overall package. Read the  full patch notes here, or the quick improvements summary below.
 
Improvements
  In-game achievements menu added. This handy update shows how close you are to reaching specific achievements. It’s accessible from the Main Menu and during combat when the game is paused.
  Added the ability to swap between Normal and Pro paint scheme for character vehicles, once that character is completed.
  Message box and Discord button added to Main Menu.
  Moved version info about game to Options.

notes.title: Photo competition: What is it and the T&Cs
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/7feb3d7dc2ddca1ca0266f60cf58d883c782ca0b.jpg

Hi everyone, 

Over these last few weeks we've been so impressed with all of your screenshots from the game that we thought... why not reward these excellent images!

To that end, we've decided to host a Dark Future Photo Competition every month, with the winner taking home an awesome prize!

Below are all the details and information you:

Competition Rules

 Check out the theme for the month (posted on the News and Discussion Page)
 Get into the game and get those screenshots (Need help with the screenshots? Check out this handy guide!)
 Submit the photos to the screenshots page on Steam. 
 Share the link by the closing date (date in the pinned post!)
 We'll pick the best one
 The winner gets that months Prize!


Other bits


 No more than three submissions (and by that we mean three links)
 Auroch Digtial will manage and administer the competition and any questions should be sent through to AurochMatt on Steam in the first instance


Capiche? 

So what are you waiting for? The first competition is live now and you can submit your photos on the theme of Explosions over on the Discussion Page

notes.title: Dark Future Post Launch Round-Up
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Was it only last week that Dark Future: Blood Red States came out? We hope you guys have been having an awesome time with it and causing as much mayhem and chaos as you can!

To do a mini-roundup of news for you:

Podcast

The latest episode of our podcast has gone live. This season has focused on Dark Future from its role in the car combat genre to the game you see before you.

This weeks episode is a special one though as we speak with James Swallow, one of the original writers in the Dark Future novels. The New York Times bestselling authour tells us more about his role in the books and in the game itself.

Take a listen now

Updates

We've implemented two updates already to the game. The first is called Duffield and includes the following changes:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/0dbf35157179558ed36e126be641ab94e8735388.png

Full patch notes are available on the Discussions page

Mugginton

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/c084198471fdd667ccbe5862d54da7e4307a2472.png

Full patch notes are available on the Discussions page

Developers Archive

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/1ed273a4513eec1996ed396dea25007547cefdb3.png

Eagle-eyed fans might have spotted the Developers Archive that has appeared as DLC on the Dark Future page! This is a chance for you to see the many iterations the game went through since it was announced in 2014.

If you are also a fan of the Dark Future board game it includes a free PDF of the original rules and expansion White Line Fever

Take a look now

Soundtrack

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/aade87a5c240e51b2e71778d87e5630841e8709c.png

Want to rock out to the sounds of Dark Future? Well, you can get the whole soundtrack, composed and produced by the excellent Matthew Walker, now on Steam!

Heads up

We have a new update coming up soon that we wanted to give you an early heads up about! More details from game producer Peter on the Discussion page.

Till next time!

notes.title: Beta Weekend UPDATE!
notes.content:
UPDATE: So after all the too and fro, we have had the confirmation that the keys are coming. The new plan is a release on Thursday 18th April at 17:00 (UK Time).  You can find more details on our update.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/42675edfbe970882cb0f69966dcb568b3dbcaac9.png

Do you want to get your hands on an early access beta build of Dark Future: Blood Red States? Well today is your lucky day!

We are looking for people to take part in a beta weekend of this upcoming title and it couldn't be easier to take part.



 Step 1: [strike]Visit this link and add your email address to the system[/strike] Sorry, now closed!
 Step 2: Get a confirmation email
 Step 3: We'll send you an access code 
 Step 4: Log into Steam and redeem your code
 Step 5: Step into Dark Future: Blood Red States
 Step 6: Explode cars and be exploded lots
 Step 7: Fill in the feedback form
 Step 8: Get a code to get 5% off the game on launch 
(and it works with any other sales we MAY or MAY NOT do *heavy wink*)


On Monday 14th April at 10:00 (UK Time) the keys will expire. The feedback form will close at 12:00PM (UK Time).

So what are you waiting for? Get involved now!
